messages:
Olivia (CS): Quick sync — AcmeFlow demos started showing demo-slowdowns during investor calls. Seen ~p95 spikes, demo team worried; renewal touchpoint in 5 days.
Ravi (SE): Can you paste numbers? and a sample problematic request?
Olivia (CS): p50 ~160ms, p95 ~1.5s for 256-512 token interactions during demo burst (peaks ~25rps). Error rate stable, but users complain about perceived sluggishness.
Nora (Infra): Load looks fine on GPUs but we see repeated KV cache cold starts. Their app sends a mix of short single-turn and long few-shot prompts which thrashes the prefix cache.
Dex (Solutions): Two quick levers: (A) model mix -> swap hot routes to microfast-xt-int8 which has ~2x lower KV footprint, (B) routing policy: route demo-tagged requests to low-latency pool + enable prefix_cache for system prompts.
Ravi (SE): I'll audit fidelity on their prompt set. If microfast-xt-int8 keeps completion quality within our 1% tolerance on intent extraction, we can roll 15% canary.
Olivia (CS): 15% seems reasonable. Need minimal customer-facing message that we're doing a targeted performance rollout to improve demo reliability.
Nora (Infra): Here's a sample JSON policy snippet to apply as a route override (canary 15%):
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {
      "name": "acmeflow-demo-fastpath",
      "match": [{"path": "/v1/chat/generate", "header": {"name": "x-demo-flag", "value": "true"}}],
      "policy": {
        "canary": 0.15,
        "prefer_pools": ["latency-rtx-pool"],
        "model_fallback": "microfast-xt-int8",
        "toggles": {"prefix_cache": true, "kv_compress": "aggressive"},
        "monitoring": ["p50","p95","error_rate","quality_score"]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
Nora (Infra): I'll wire up a dashboard and an alert: trigger if canary p95 > 700ms for 3m or quality_score drops > 1.5 points vs baseline.
Ravi (SE): Running local eval on ~200 customer prompts: intent accuracy flat, but a couple of generative quality samples show slightly shorter completions (avg length -3 tokens). I'll post details.
Dex (Solutions): Good to have fallback plan: if quality signal fails, switch to "int8-with-kv-compress" toggle instead of model swap. That preserves model behavior but reduces footprint.
OpsBot: deploy request queued -> job #deploy-9901 (canary=15%).
Olivia (CS): Action list: Ravi -> full eval + 2-minute summary (ETA 45m); Nora -> canary + dashboard + alert (ETA 20m); Dex -> draft customer note emphasizing improved demo SLA and rollback plan (ETA 30m).
Ravi (SE): Update: first 200 evals: intent recall unchanged, BLEU-like paraphrase metric -0.4, quality_score delta -0.2 (within threshold). Uploading results to /enablement/acmeflow/evals.csv
Nora (Infra): Canary live. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/teams/acmeflow/canary-9901. Current canary stats: p50 120ms, p95 360ms, no error uptick.
Olivia (CS): Nice. Dex, once you have the note, I'll send to the renewal lead. We'll keep thread open for 24h monitoring.
Dex (Solutions): Draft ready and shared in the doc — callout: "Projected demo conversion lift from decreased tail latency. Rollout safe with rollback to baseline model if quality alert fires."
Olivia (CS): Thanks everyone. Will update renewal tracker and mark as mitigated if stable for 24h.
